cohort: 919 high school students in Palermo, Italy
finding: Multiple factors were associated with overweight/obesity and cardiometabolic risk in Italian adolescents, including male gender, overweight/obese parents, following a slimming regime, caesarean birth, sedentariness, being under/overweight at birth, presence of metabolic risk, going to school by car/scooter, and not using supplements.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with increased risk of overweight/obesity and cardiometabolic risk in Italian adolescents.
